_comment: TEST-DISCOVER topology consumption from EPIC-PREP ref, COVERAGE delivery/oracle bindings, and ANALYSE exploration_suppressed. Playbook: .cursor/pipelines/test-discover.md Steps A, B, E, F. Verifier: automation/tools/discover_verify.py --strict-topology. Upstream: docs/epic-prep-topology-contract.json, docs/coverage-topology-contract.json, docs/analysis-topology-contract.json.

fields.oracle_rule: enum from ref rule row (e.g. first_tier_quote, text_configuration_closest_gte_qty, console_show_prices_first_tier, unresolved)
fields.volume_control: from ref rule row (e.g. first_tier, order_default_qty, not_applicable)
fields.surface: ref rule surface id (e.g. dxtrade5_watchlist, dxtrade5_derivatives, console_show_prices)

oracle_binding.emit_on: verification_affordances[] when linked primary check has oracle_rule_id and disposition is not tooling_blocked for delivery

unresolved_rule.note: ANALYSE owns surface_oracle_unresolved gap; discover does not re-emit gap rows

oracle_binding.summary_norm: Affordance summary MUST name surface-specific oracle (e.g. first_tier_quote on Derivatives), not generic tier-appropriate language

ledger_delivery_disposition.disposition_note: Cite analysis gap id and/or ref delivery_note_id; honest delivery blocker — not rework churn

ledger_deferred_disposition.note: Do not auto-scope_gap on !-only primaries or keyed deferrals; fixture_need_mapped with disposition_note citing obligation_id (639 XT-7911; Round 2 deferral_obligation_keyed from ANALYSE step 3)

work_queue.merge_oracle_rules: Union ref pricing_oracle_rules with coverage checks[].oracle_rule_id; bind affordances from ref rule row when both present
work_queue.skip_probes_for: check_ids with tooling_blocked delivery disposition or exploration_suppressed blocks_fixture_probe for delivery reasons

shell_first_probes.surfaces_example: Watchlist vs Position Book vs Derivatives via jss-001..jss-004

forbidden: scope_gap on delivery-blocked primary checks (delivery_known_fail, delivery_excluded, coverage delivery_status failed/excluded)
inventing oracle_rule text not present on ref pricing_oracle_rules
CRTQA structural input when crtqa_index_enabled is false
widening obligation universe beyond primary coverage checks

checks: delivery-suppressed primary check_ids → ledger tooling_blocked, not scope_gap
each primary coverage check with oracle_rule_id (non-delivery-blocked) → linked affordance with matching oracle_binding.oracle_rule_id
each ref pricing_oracle_rules row with disposition primary_candidate → ≥1 linked affordance with oracle_binding OR primary check tooling_blocked for delivery
no oracle_binding required when ref/coverage have no oracle topology (639 regression)
legacy discover without topology_loaded: strict mode no-op when ref has empty delivery_notes and pricing_oracle_rules

downstream_handoff.coverage_reinforce: verification_affordances slice + topology_surface_id split for shell_first — see .cursor/pipelines/coverage-reinforce.md (5/8); no reinforce implementation in TEST-DISCOVER
